hints: You work for the Festeron Post Office. The score goes up to 100. You never need to use any wishes. Do the steps in number order; each move says in brackets which room it leads to. After every move check that the room name matches; if it doesn't, go back to the last room that matched. When the game asks a YES/NO question, answer yes.
Once you have the small stone (Wishbringer), never drop it except where a step says so: it is your light.

DEADLINE: the Magick Shoppe closes at five o'clock (type time to see the time; the game starts at 3:00). If you haven't given the envelope to the old woman by then, Mr. Crisp fires you and the game ends. Steps 1-3 take about 45 minutes of game time, so do them straight away, in order, with no detours: don't explore, don't go to the lake, and don't touch the pit or the leaves there (moving the leaves costs 10 points).

Step 1, the envelope and the poodle. You start on the Hilltop. Type: south (Post Office), wait, take envelope, north (Hilltop), west (Outside Cemetery), west (Creepy Corner) (answer yes), north (Spooky Copse), examine gravedigger, show envelope to gravedigger, examine grave, west (Twilight Glen), east (Spooky Copse), down (Open Grave), take bone, up (Spooky Copse), south (Creepy Corner), east (Outside Cemetery), east (Hilltop), east (Outside Cottage), give bone to poodle.

Step 2, the note, the coin and the Magick Shoppe. From Outside Cottage: north (Rotary South), wait, take note, north (Park), west (Rotary West), enter police station (Police Station), then type wait until Sgt. MacGuffin "begins to snore", take chocolate, out (Rotary West), east (Park), look in fountain, take coin, north (Rotary North), north (South of Bridge), north (Bridge), north (North of Bridge), east (Cliff Bottom; don't take the branch now), up (Steep Trail), west (Steep Trail), north (Steep Trail), up (Steep Trail), east (Steep Trail), south (Steep Trail), up (Cliff Edge), open door, in (Magick Shoppe). The trail up the cliff twists: follow it exactly. Leave the branch at Cliff Bottom alone for now: you take it in step 4a, after the Magick Shoppe. The chocolate is your emergency way out of jail (see THE BOOT PATROL): never eat it unless a hint says so.

Step 3, the old woman. In the Magick Shoppe: wait, wait, give envelope to woman, open envelope, read letter to woman, wait, take can, wait, wait. She sends you out into a nightmare version of the town.

Step 4a, the branch. From Cliff Edge, through the fog: down (Fog), north (Fog), west (Fog), down (Fog), south (Fog), east (Fog), down (Cliff Bottom), take branch, take branch. The first "take branch" only snaps the branch off; the second one picks it up. There is no troll at Cliff Bottom: do nothing else here.

Step 4b, the troll and Wishbringer. From Cliff Bottom go west (North of Bridge), where the troll stands at the toll gate. Only there type: give can to troll. He opens it himself, a rattlesnake jumps out and he runs away. Then: take can, squeeze can, take stone (this is Wishbringer), open gate, drop can (you don't need it again, and you'll need the room later). NEVER open the can yourself and NEVER give the gold coin to the troll: if the snake is let out anywhere else, or the troll gets the coin, you can't get past him and you need the coin later.

Step 5, the platypus and the hat. From North of Bridge: south (Bridge), south (South of Bridge), west (River Outlet), south (Lake Edge), look in pit, put branch in pit, take branch, drop branch, dig in sand, take whistle, blow whistle (Misty Island), west (Throne Room), wait, take hat, wait, blow whistle (Lake Edge). Don't forget "drop branch" after pulling the platypus out: you never need the branch again, and carrying it makes your load too heavy later. The king gives you the hat; the second whistle takes you back to Lake Edge.

GETTING DOWN THE HOLE IN THE JAIL CELL: you can't climb down the hole holding things, and things dropped on the floor stay in the cell. You must put each thing INTO THE HOLE, one at a time, keeping only the small stone: put blanket in hole, put hat in hole, put coin in hole, put note in hole, put worm in hole, put chocolate in hole (whichever of these you hold). Each one should say "disappears into the hole". Never type "drop all" or "drop all except stone" in the cell. When you hold only the small stone: down (Underground), take all.

Step 6, the blanket. THE CEMETERY IS HAUNTED AT NIGHT and you have no spare turns: from Lake Edge type exactly south (answer yes) (Twilight Glen), east (Spooky Copse), down (Open Grave), with nothing in between. Don't take the umbrella, don't look around, don't wait, or ghostly vapors carry you off. Then: north (Underground), east (Underground), push bunk, up (Jail Cell), take blanket, put blanket in hole, put hat in hole, put coin in hole, put note in hole, put chocolate in hole, down (Underground), take all. Push the bunk from below before going up. See GETTING DOWN THE HOLE.

IF THE VAPORS CARRY YOU OFF ("scatter your possessions"): you wake up empty-handed somewhere in town, and your things are dropped in different rooms all over town (for example River Outlet, Lighthouse, Wharf's End, Lookout Hill, Cliff Bottom). Walk around town and take back at least the small stone, the gold coin, the violet note and the wizard's hat. Then go back to Lake Edge and do step 6 again without stopping in the cemetery.

Step 7, the grue and the worm. From the Underground under the jail cell: north (Underground), east (Grue's Nest), put blanket on grue, open fridge, take worm, west (Underground), west (Underground), open stump, up (Lookout Hill). The blanket keeps the baby grue asleep.

Step 8, the magic word. From Lookout Hill: north (River Outlet), east (South of Bridge), east (Rocky Path), east (Lighthouse), give hat to pelican. The lighthouse beam spells a magic word on a cloud, for example KALUZE. The word is different in every game: write it in a NOTE. You need it in step 12.

THE BOOT PATROL: at night a platoon of giant boots walks a fixed loop through the town's outdoor rooms, one room a turn: Rotary South, Rotary East, Pleasure Wharf, Wharf's End and back, Park, Rotary West, Rotary North, South of Bridge, Rocky Path, Lighthouse and back, River Outlet, Lookout Hill and back, Lake Edge, and round again. If you're in the same room, they catch you. Rules: (1) Never wait or explore in those rooms: keep walking the route. (2) When the game says "It sounds as if they're coming this way!", step into a safe place if one is next to you (down the stump into the Underground from Lookout Hill, the Theater Lobby from Rotary East, the Video Arcade from Pleasure Wharf), wait one turn, then carry on. (3) If they catch you, escape from the Jail Cell AT ONCE (after about 20 turns in the cell you are taken away and the game ends). Don't count visits; look at the room description: if it says "There's a dark, narrow hole in the floor", escape through the hole as in step 9. If it doesn't mention a hole (the bunk is against the wall; the hole has been sealed with concrete), type: take all, eat chocolate, wish for freedom. The Stone takes you out to Lookout Hill with your things.

Step 9, the Boot Patrol. From the Lighthouse: west (Rocky Path), west (South of Bridge), south (Rotary North), south (Park), east (Rotary East). Around this time the Boot Patrol catches you and throws you in the Jail Cell; that's expected. If the cell description says "There's a dark, narrow hole in the floor", escape at once: take all, then put each thing in the hole except the small stone (see GETTING DOWN THE HOLE), down (Underground), take all, north (Underground), west (Underground), wait (the Boots pass by overhead), up (Lookout Hill), north (River Outlet), east (South of Bridge), south (Rotary North), south (Park). If there is no hole, use the chocolate instead (see THE BOOT PATROL, rule 3). If you haven't been caught yet, just carry on with step 10 and escape like this whenever it happens.

Step 10, the token and the movie. In the Park: drop worm in fountain, take token (the piranha eats the worm). Then: east (Rotary East), buy ticket with coin, enter theatre (Theater Lobby), give ticket to gravedigger, north (Inside Theater), sit down, look under seat, take glasses, wear glasses, look, look, look, look, look, stand up, take off glasses. Go into the theater straight after buying the ticket. Keep looking at the screen until "Poof! The image on the screen goes black". Keep the 3D glasses.

Step 11, the arcade. From Inside Theater: south (Theater Lobby). If the lobby says "You can hear the tramp of marching boots outside", the Boots are just outside: type wait four times before leaving. Then: exit theatre (answer yes) (Rotary East), east (Pleasure Wharf), south (Video Arcade), put token in machine, move joystick west, again, move joystick south, again, press red button (answer yes, then yes again). The machine sends you to the Hilltop outside the tower. As you leave the theater, Miss Voss notices your gold coin is fake and phones the Boots, so go straight east and south into the Video Arcade without stopping.

Step 12, the tower. On the Hilltop type: say WORD, using the word from step 8 (for example: say kaluze). Then: south (Vestibule), wait, give note to mr crisp, take coat, look in coat, take key, unlock chains with key, pull lever, take note, read note, open hatch, up (Round Chamber). Giving Mr. Crisp the violet note from Miss Voss makes him leave; the key in his coat unlocks your chains; the lever frees Princess Tasmania; her note tells you the poodle's command.

Step 13, the lab and the drawbridge. In the Round Chamber: look behind paintings, up (Fuzziness), wear glasses (Laboratory), take broom, turn second switch off, down (Fuzziness), take off glasses (Round Chamber), turn crank, north (Vestibule), north (Hilltop), east (Outside Cottage). Upstairs is blurry until you wear the 3D glasses. Turning off the second switch (Security) and turning the crank behind the painting opens the drawbridge.

Step 14, the end. At Outside Cottage: alexis, heel, open door, enter cottage (Cottage), take key, exit cottage (Outside Cottage), north (Rotary South), unlock library door with steel key, enter library (Circulation Desk), south, south (Museum), break case with broom, examine sculpture, put wishbringer in hole (answer yes, then yes again), pet cat, knock on door.
